description: Measures frequency deviation and PPM offset of 32.768kHz LFCLK relative to HFCLK reference.
help_text:
⏱️ [HFCLK vs LFCLK Drift Setup Guide]

1. Reference: 64MHz HFCLK Crystal Timer
2. Target: 32.768kHz External LFCLK Oscillator
3. Pass Criteria: Drift Offset within ±Max PPM
4. Firmware Source Code: https://github.com/olleheugene/lfxo_drift_sanity_check
name: HFCLK vs LFCLK Drift Test
